# Zubair Bin Shaukat

> Zubair Bin Shaukat is a software engineer based in Lahore, Pakistan. He
> builds business automation systems with n8n, custom GoHighLevel dashboards
> and marketplace apps, web applications with Next.js and React, and
> cross-platform mobile applications with React Native. He works directly with
> founders and white-label for agencies, on fixed-scope engagements.

Also known as: Zubyr, Zubair Shaukat.
Contact: thedevzubair@gmail.com
Canonical site: https://www.zubyr.dev

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.zubyr.dev/): Overview of the four services, selected case studies, how the work runs, and the FAQ.
- [About](https://www.zubyr.dev/about): Fact-dense third-person profile — role, location, stack, and what he takes on.
- [GoHighLevel Development](https://www.zubyr.dev/services/gohighlevel): Custom dashboards mounted inside the platform, marketplace apps with OAuth, sub-account provisioning, API v2 integrations.
- [n8n & Workflow Automation](https://www.zubyr.dev/services/automation): Manual processes rebuilt as n8n pipelines with retries, idempotency, an exception queue and a runbook.
- [Web Development](https://www.zubyr.dev/services/web-development): Client portals, internal tools and web applications in Next.js, React, TypeScript and Postgres.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.zubyr.dev/services/mobile): Cross-platform iOS and Android apps in React Native and Expo, built offline-first.
- [Projects](https://www.zubyr.dev/projects): Selected work written up as case studies — problem, approach, outcome.
- [Blog](https://www.zubyr.dev/blog): Engineering notes on automation, platform APIs and mobile sync.
- [Contact](https://www.zubyr.dev/contact): How to start a project, and what to include in a first message.
